name: 7162-fixedlen-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU, SM90, driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1; one in-process engine on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup the first 25% by completion, bounded at 1000 requests / 1800 s safety.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: exactly 512 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min = max on both), zero variance, 1000 requests, plain completions with no chat template, n=1 temperature 1.0 top_p 1.0 top_k unrestricted, ignore_eos so every request runs all 256 decode steps.
purpose: A text completion service on an eight-billion-parameter model, serving 256 concurrent uniform half-page prompts on one GPU.
launch:
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
pipeline-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 131072
# Written out deliberately: at this engine version an UNSET flag auto-enables chunked prefill for
# any context window above 32768, and this checkpoint's is 131072. Confirm it reads off in the
# engine's startup log.
enable-chunked-prefill: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 131072
enforce-eager: false
block-size: 16
swap-space: 4
seed: 0
disable-log-stats: true
